scope: ZUVYR internal actionable security/reliability/performance hygiene discovered during continuous-improvement reconciliation

continuous_monitoring.maintenance_behavior: Any hygiene RPC error or non-zero monitored drift prevents the maintenance coordinator from creating a success marker and is recorded in the maintenance receipt.
monitored_invariants: ZUVYR public RLS-enabled tables with zero policy = 0
ZUVYR public foreign keys without a covering index = 0

ci.head: adcd9d929cf7b7abc0e7a305eb469d8739aaf0cb
ci.initial_failure_reason: Canonical continuous-improvement policy files changed without atomically refreshing their manifest blob snapshots; manifest was reconciled and the continuity validator then passed.

intentionally_accepted_informational_fin.finding: no_primary_key on eight tables in historical backup schemas
intentionally_accepted_informational_fin.rationale: These are backup/receipt/definition snapshots outside the public runtime schema. Adding synthetic primary keys solely to silence an advisor would mutate backup fidelity without a runtime correctness benefit. They remain non-runtime historical artifacts.

intentionally_accepted_informational_fin.finding: unused_index advisor entries, including 164 newly-created FK covering indexes
intentionally_accepted_informational_fin.rationale: All 164 new FK indexes necessarily had zero scans immediately after creation. They were created to enforce FK-operation/query coverage and need real traffic/statistics time before any removal decision. Existing older unused-index entries also require workload evidence before destructive cleanup; advisor zero-scan alone is insufficient evidence to drop production indexes.
NOVA8 is a separate product sharing the database. This ZUVYR hardening deliberately does not mutate nova8_* objects.

explicit_external_blockers.fresh_evidence: Supabase Security Advisor still reports auth_leaked_password_protection as WARN / disabled.
explicit_external_blockers.historical_gate_evidence: PACK009 recorded an HTTP 402/current-plan limitation when attempting the setting.
explicit_external_blockers.why_not_autofixed: The connected Supabase tool surface does not expose Auth password-security configuration mutation; no fake completion is permitted.
explicit_external_blockers.required_action: Enable leaked-password protection in Supabase Auth password security once the project plan/settings permit it, then rerun the security advisor and record a fresh receipt.

explicit_external_blockers.fresh_evidence: GitHub reports main protected=false and repository rulesets=[] on 2026-09-23.
explicit_external_blockers.why_not_autofixed: The connected GitHub action surface can read branch/ruleset state but does not expose repository-administration writes for branch protection/rulesets.
explicit_external_blockers.required_action: Enable a main-branch ruleset/branch protection requiring pull requests and the canonical green quality/continuity checks, then verify the ruleset through fresh GitHub evidence.

explicit_external_blockers.fresh_evidence: Canonical continuity state keeps PACK089 89E blocked on real Google OAuth validation and owner consent; PACK090 remains disallowed.
explicit_external_blockers.owner: ZUVYR owner / Google Cloud OAuth owner
explicit_external_blockers.required_action: Complete real owner-scoped production Google OAuth consent, granted-scope action, denied-scope proof, revoke/disconnect proof and audit/secret-cleanliness acceptance before PACK089 can be locked and PACK090 opened.

non_claims: This receipt does not claim the entire ZUVYR project is globally CLEAN while external blockers remain.
This receipt does not claim NOVA8 is clean or modify NOVA8.
This receipt does not treat newly-created zero-scan indexes as removable without workload evidence.
This receipt does not advance PACK089 or allow PACK090.
result: All actionable internal ZUVYR database hygiene findings identified by this reconciliation are closed and production-verified; future drift is monitored by the maintenance invariant. Remaining items are explicitly external, separate-product, or intentionally accepted informational findings with rationale.
